_meta.purpose: Reference glossary for the react-i18next migration on feat/i18n-foundation. Harvest the Chinese translations from here; the runtime patch mechanism itself is NOT reused.
cleaningRules: Source/English strings containing CJK characters were dropped (these are 'patch-of-patch' artifacts, e.g. ['标注 全部任务','全部标注任务'], which exist only to fix earlier mistranslations).
Entries deduped by English source; first occurrence kept.
Surface grouping is a best-effort keyword heuristic — verify bucket placement when migrating. Use the 'alphabetical' index for lookup.
_meta.usage: When migrating a component: 1) scan the matching surface bucket for the strings you encounter; 2) copy the Chinese into the component's locales/zh-CN/<namespace>.json under a stable camelCase key; 3) wrap the source string with t('namespace:key'). Dynamic text (counts, dates) should be modeled with i18next interpolation/plurals — see 'patterns' for intent.
_meta.pilotAdditions: Strings absent from the upstream patch were translated during the feat/i18n-foundation pilot migrations and fed back here: the 3 Projects-list empty-state strings, plus "Cancel project creation" from the CreateProject modal.
